name: Barangay Clearance Information
short: Overview of how a residence clearance is typically requested.
detail: A clearance is a sample certificate confirming a resident has no pending local record. This entry explains an illustrative process only.
steps: Gather your ID and proof of residence.
Fill out the request form at the demo desk.
Submit documents and wait to be called.
notes: Fees and rules are fictional. Verify with your local office.

name: Certificate of Residency Information
short: How proof of residence is typically requested.
detail: A residency certificate is a sample document stating that a person lives in a community. Details here are examples only.
steps: Submit the form to the records desk.
Review the certificate for correct spelling.
notes: Some offices require a recent proof of address.

name: Certificate of Indigency Information
short: Sample guidance for requesting a low-income certificate.
detail: This entry describes how a certificate supporting assistance applications might be requested in a demo community.

name: Community Assistance Information
short: General overview of sample aid programs.
detail: Lists the kinds of aid a community may offer, such as food packs or emergency relief, and how residents may inquire.
steps: Check which program fits your need.
Submit a request at the welfare desk.
notes: Availability is not guaranteed in this demo.

name: Senior Citizen Assistance Information
short: Sample support information for older residents.
detail: Describes example benefits and registration steps for senior residents, such as ID registration and wellness days.

name: Persons with Disabilities Assistance Information
short: Sample guidance on registration and support.
detail: Explains how residents with disabilities could register for support services in this fictional community.
steps: Visit the welfare desk or ask a representative to go.
notes: Representatives may apply on a resident's behalf in this demo.

name: Community Health Program Information
detail: Overview of example immunization days, checkups and health talks offered by a demo health center.
steps: Arrive early and bring your record.

name: Youth Development Program Information
detail: Explains example programs such as skills workshops, sports leagues and tutoring.
requirements: Parent or guardian consent if under 18 (sample)
notes: Slots are limited in this demo.

name: Business Permit Guidance
short: Sample steps for a small business permit.
detail: A fictional walkthrough of preparing a small business application.

name: Waste Collection Information
short: Sample garbage collection schedules and segregation tips.
detail: Explains example collection days, segregation categories and how to report missed collection.
steps: Place waste out before the collection time.

name: Community Event Registration Information
short: Sample steps to register for events.
detail: Describes how residents might sign up for fairs, clean-up drives and seminars.

name: Community Complaint Procedure
short: Sample process for filing a complaint.
detail: Explains an illustrative process for submitting and following up on community concerns.
